title: Plumage Pigments Identification by High-Performance Liquid Chromatography
author: Guangqi Gao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sjtecnn

steps.title: Remove Surface Lipids
steps.instruction: Soak each type of coloured feather in ethanol and then in hexanes to remove surface lipids.

steps.title: Extract Carotenoid Pigments
steps.instruction: Extract pigments from feather barbs using acidified pyridine and heat.

substeps.instruction: Trim pigmented barbs into pieces and weigh them.
Place pieces into a 10ml tightly capped glass tube.
Infuse 1ml acidified pyridine to cover the pieces.
Fill the tube with argon gas.
Place the tube in a 368K water bath for 3 h.

steps.title: Separate and Recover Pigments
steps.instruction: Separate carotenoid pigments from the solution and prepare for storage.

substeps.instruction: Cool the tube to room temperature.
Add 2 ml pure water and 1ml hexane: tert-butyl methyl ether (1:1) to the tube.
Shake the mixture vigorously for 2 min.
Centrifuge at 3000 rpm for 5 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a clean tube.
Dry the supernatant under nitrogen gas.
Store the dried pigment at 193 K.

steps.title: Analyze Carotenoids via HPLC
steps.instruction: Perform HPLC analysis on the dried carotenoid pigments.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve dried pigment in HPLC mobile phase (methanol/acetonitrile, 50:50 v/v, +0.05% triethylamine).
Filter the solution through a nylon syringe filter.
Inject into an SIL-20A HPLC system (Shimadzu, Japan) equipped with a YMC C-30 Carotenoid column (5 μm, 4.6 mm × 250 mm; YMC, Japan) and an SPD-20A UV/Vis detector (Shimadzu, Japan).
Run an isocratic system at a flow rate of 1.5 ml/min for 40 min.
Collect data at 450 nm.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Porphyrin Analysis
steps.instruction: Process feather barbs to prepare for TTCA and PTCA analysis.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 20 mg of barbs and grind into powder in liquid nitrogen.
Allow powder to warm to room temperature.
Infuse 2 ml pure water to the powder.
Place 200 μl of the resulting suspension into a 10ml glass tube.
Add 750 μl 1 mol/l K2CO3 and 50 μl 30% H2O2 to the tube.

steps.title: Decompose and Acidify Solution
steps.instruction: React the mixture and prepare the solution for HPLC injection.

substeps.instruction: Shake the mixtures at 298K for 20 h.
Add 100 μl 10% Na2SO3 to decompose residual H2O2.
Add 280 μl 6 mol/l HCl to acidify the solution.
Centrifuge the reaction products at 4000 g for 1 min.

steps.title: Analyze TTCA and PTCA via HPLC
steps.instruction: Perform HPLC analysis on the supernatant to identify TTCA and PTCA.

substeps.instruction: Inject an aliquot of each supernatant into the SIL-20A HPLC system equipped with a Wondasil C18 column (5 μm, 4.6 mm × 250 mm; GL Sciences, Japan).
Use a mobile phase of 0.1 mol/l potassium phosphate buffer (pH 2.1) / methanol, 99:1 (v/v).
Set the temperature to 318K and the flow rate to 0.7 ml/min.
Collect data at 269 nm.
